summary: Fee-Wächter (Option 1) end-to-end verified. Backend defaults (fee_guard_enabled=true, fee_guard_mult=4.0) exposed via GET /api/ai/status. POST /api/ai/config admin update with {enabled:false, mult:99} correctly clamps mult to 30 and disables the guard. Restore to {true, 4} works. Python unit tests: test_fee_guard.py 6/6 PASS, test_phase4_collection_mode.py 7/7 PASS, test_ram_and_manager_guards.py 9/9 PASS (pytest). Frontend: AITradingPanel Setup section shows new controls 'Fee-Wächter' (ai-fee-guard-enabled-select) and 'Fee-Faktor (× Fees)' (ai-fee-guard-mult-select) right after 'KI-Limit Cooldown'; toggle to 'aus' persists after page reload; restore to 'an' + 4x works. Existing setup controls (ai-tune-conf-min-select, ai-collection-enabled-select, ai-tune-cooldown-max-select) still present with correct defaults. Defaults restored at end: fee_guard_enabled=true, fee_guard_mult=4, KI-Trader enabled=false (unchanged).

Sammel-Trades'; enforcement in bitunix_trade.on_signal writes a Governance chat entry ONLY for non-collection trades - the wording is fine but confirm intended UX (collection trades are still blocked silently).
